861:t_097:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「In that case, $$グーラ$$... we'll show you the charm of SRW.」

861:t_097:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Players, please come back soon and teach $$グーラ$$ how fun SRW is!」

861:t_097:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ is waiting for you, too!」

861:t_098:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Well, well, if it isn't $$宇宙太$$ and even $$恵子$$! ...What are you two up to?」

861:t_098:4.en:
$$恵子$$
「Honestly! We're saying our goodbyes because the player is quitting the game!」

861:t_098:5.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Geez, you came all the way here without even knowing that?」

861:t_098:7.en:
$$恵子$$
「Hey! $$勝平$$! You too, $$宇宙太$$! ...Sorry about this, everyone. Please get a good rest!」

861:t_098:8.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「If you can, start playing again soon, okay!」

861:t_099:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「The last and greatest battle, launched by an enemy stronger than any before...」

861:t_099:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「The $$神ファミリー$$ and their comrades keep resisting, together with the feelings of the people.」

861:t_099:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「And what lies at the end of that battle...」

861:t_099:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Next time, 'Long Live SRW'. Now then, how will you fight your way through?」

861:t_099:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Heh heh... Did you hear that, Grandpa? I've really made something of myself, haven't I...?」

861:t_100:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「Whaaat? You're stopping in a spot like this? I want to know what happens next, too, so let's play a little more, come on!」

861:t_100:4.en:
$$青山$$
「Don't ask the impossible of the player. Even we'd get sick of overtime every single day, right?」

861:t_100:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Sure, but that's where you push through with 'Spirit' and 'Vigor'!」

861:t_100:6.en:
$$青山$$
「Players, everyone, don't fall for $$赤木$$'s smooth talk and waste precious Spirit Commands here.」

861:t_100:7.en:
$$青山$$
「So here's 'Bless' and 'Cheer' from me to you.」

861:t_100:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「You! You had commands like that!?」

861:t_100:9.en:
$$青山$$
「Those are for private use. ...Well then, players, see you again.」

861:t_100:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「What's that supposed to mean, 'for private use'...?」

861:t_101:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that is all for this time? In that case, I shall enjoy a brief rest myself.」

861:t_101:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「However, the protagonist of this story is, above all, you. There is no story without a protagonist.」

861:t_101:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I continue to play $$ロジャー・スミス$$, I would like you to keep playing the lead.」

861:t_101:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And now, a brief farewell. Let us meet again in the world of 'Super Robot Wars'.」

861:t_102:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems even you and I are due for a rest... Rest is something everyone needs, and enjoying it requires a certain something...」

861:t_102:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, R. $$ドロシー#bigo$$... coffee, please. And as I have told you many times, no milk and no sugar. Black.」

861:t_102:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Coffee strong and bitter, conversation with a woman light and sweet... That is how I would like life to be.」

861:t_102:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am used to human women saying that to me.」

861:t_103:3.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Too optimistic... Even at under 10% odds, it hits when it hits...!」

861:t_103:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Go back to where I saved? No, it's no good! Even if I were willing, time won't allow it.」

861:t_103:5.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「It's already the time limit... there's no time to go back...! Then the answer I must choose is...!」

861:t_104:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Oh, um... thanks for playing. You'll start up again right away next time, won't you? Otherwise...」

861:t_104:4.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Hey, what kind of greeting is that? You're far too unfriendly. And you've got no sex appeal, either.」

861:t_104:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「You're one to talk, you're unfriendly too!」

861:t_104:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Then I'll show you my trump card...」

861:t_104:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Um, Master... I'll do anything, so please come back quickly!」

861:t_104:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「Huh!? What was that just now!?」

861:t_105:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A game is born... through the actions the player takes.」

861:t_105:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A game moves... through the choices the player makes.」

861:t_105:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Yes, this game is about to move on to its next form.」

861:t_105:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Be sure to come back. So that the hands that mark time never stop...」

861:t_106:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「How about taking off the mask during the interlude, $$ルルーシュ$$?」

861:t_106:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「This is my own way of drawing the line. I decided to live as $$ゼロ$$.」

861:t_106:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Just try having a masked man next to you right when you're about to rest. You couldn't relax if you tried.」

861:t_106:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Now all that's left is to greet them with a smile.」

861:t_106:9.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Even without my saying it, the player must already know. What they themselves should accomplish...」

861:t_106:10.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So you've become able to trust others, too. Now I can rest easy as well.」

861:t_107:3.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I, $$ルルーシュ・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, command you!」

861:t_107:4.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「Players, return to the game at once and clear SRW as quickly as possible!」

861:t_107:5.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「...is what I'd like to say, but this is not an order by $$ギアス$$. It is a request from me.」

861:t_107:6.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「I look forward to meeting you again. Show me your miracle of victory.」

861:t_108:3.en:
$$モーム$$
「Players, everyone, good work. You were a great help again this time.」

861:t_108:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Though it's rough on those of us who get worked like dogs.」

861:t_108:5.en:
$$モーム$$
「$$桂$$! If you keep complaining, you'll get benched!」

861:t_108:6.en:
$$桂$$
「Please, anything but that. If I don't sortie, the girls will be disappointed.」

861:t_108:7.en:
$$モーム$$
「So he says, so please deploy $$桂$$ on your next sortie, too.」

861:t_108:8.en:
$$モーム$$
「I'll do my best with $$桂$$ and you, too. See you!」

861:t_109:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Suspending here, huh. Not a bad call.」

861:t_109:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Rest becomes strength for the next battle.」

861:t_109:9.en:
$$刹那$$
「But we still need your power.」

861:t_109:11.en:
$$宗介$$
(This is bad... They said everything I was about to say...)

861:t_110:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ロックオン$$... you admitted your sniping isn't on your brother's level, didn't you? Which means the No. 1 sniper is me... OK?」

861:t_110:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I may concede to my brother, but I've no intention of losing to you.」

861:t_110:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then shall we have a contest?」

861:t_110:7.en:
$$青山$$
「Cut the squabbling among allies. Besides, if you're going to take aim, rather than the enemy...」
